title.narrative: ICMPS CENTRO DE LA MUJER PERUANA FLORA TRISTAN

description.narrative: The "Creating Justice for Women and Vulnerable Populations: Legal Advice, Litigation, and Communication for a Life Free from Violence" project in Peru, implemented by Flora Tristán, aims to strengthen access to justice and contribute to a life free of violence for women and vulnerable populations, through the provision of free legal assistance, communication, and public advocacy. The initiative looks to respond to, accompany, and strengthen women and vulnerable victims of violence, while at the same time, while making visible the structural barriers of the judicial system. The key activities include providing guidance and care service for women victims of GBV, providing at least 250 consultations to women, promoting their access to justice and preventing re-victimization, provision of support in urgent cases, and dissemination of information materialpreparing and distrubuting informative brochures.
